mug-cocoa.title: Personalized Christmas Mug with Name, Custom Hot Cocoa Mug, Christmas 2026 Name Gift, Stocking Stuffer for Her, Kids Cocoa Cup
mug-cocoa.personalization_instructions: Name to print (letters only, max 18 characters). We print it exactly as typed.
mug-cocoa.description:
A cozy hot cocoa mug with YOUR name on it! ☕ Watercolor cocoa mug with marshmallows, candy cane and gingerbread, the name in red script and "Christmas 2026".

• 11oz glossy white ceramic mug
• Design printed on BOTH sides, faces the drinker in either hand
• Dishwasher and microwave safe

🎄 HOW TO ORDER
1. Choose your option.
2. Type the name in the personalization box (letters only, max 18 characters).
3. We print it EXACTLY as typed, so please double-check the spelling. We cannot change names after the order goes to print.

📦 PRODUCTION & SHIPPING
Made to order for you by our print partner (Printify) and shipped from the US. Production takes 2–5 business days, plus shipping. For Christmas delivery in the US, please order by December 10.

💛 Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools. Illustration is printed, not hand painted.
